changelog: Fix: checkbox-type strategy variables on the trade form now have a blank/unanswered state — previously the field was a two-option Yes/No select with No pre-selected, so a tag the user never looked at (e.g. AVWAP aligned, liquidity sweep, tweezer present) was silently recorded as a confirmed No, corrupting tag-attribution analysis on the Leaderboard and Review Engine

Rename: the Strategy Lab's variable-type picker now labels this type 'Yes/No' instead of 'Checkbox', matching what it actually renders as (a three-state select, not an HTML checkbox) — the underlying input_type column value is unchanged ('checkbox'), only the display label changed

Note: this does not retroactively correct existing data — pre-v3.9.4 trade_variables rows with value='0' against a checkbox-type variable cannot be distinguished between a real 'No' and a silent default; see CLAUDE.md for the query to find affected rows and the caveat not to trust them as observations until reconciled
